rows.note: Use 姓 as the all-purpose everyday word for a person's family name.
Use 姓氏 in formal or written contexts rather than the everyday 姓.

example.english: Please fill in your name and last name on the form.
example.traditional: 請喺表格上填寫姓名同姓氏。
